issue.title: Retire three_pane_splits
issue.description: From a two-pane split, the other split key splits the focused pane into a three-pane T layout on the Agents deck and in the pager; with three panes the split keys erase or turn the layout.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Both the Agents and pager three-pane phases of this epic have landed with green transition tables, goldens and live look passes; the epic unflag-docs phase deletes the Off branch.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: The other split key rotates a two-pane split and no surface ever shows a third pane.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: From a two-pane split, the other split key splits the focused pane into a three-pane T layout on the Agents deck and in the pager; with three panes the split keys erase or turn the layout.

payload.entry: three_pane_splits Off branch deleted in unflag-docs: press_split nest parameter removed, deck/pager adapters nest unconditionally, flag-off persistence truncation removed, registry entry removed, both-states tests converted to single behavior; focused suites green (pane_grid goldens+properties, pager split model, deck layout/three-panels/pilot, pager app split/three-panes)
